angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 528,732 km at 121.84 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.2073 +/- 0.0213 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10): 121.84 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.76 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Bourrier et al. 2023, the stellar radius of WASP-156 b's parameter set from Bourrier et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..63B/abstract): 528,732 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.842 +/- 0.052 solar masses from Bourrier et al. 2023, the stellar mass of WASP-156 b's parameter set from Bourrier et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..63B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5036 +/- 104 K from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-156 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.tmp..940L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-156 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.tmp..940L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-156.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.602, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-156 (pscomppars): spectral type K3 V, from Lafarga et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.tmp..940L/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, WASP-156: main object type MS*, Main Sequence Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-156 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.32 dex, from Lafarga et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.tmp..940L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-156 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.41794, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-156 (pscomppars): age 5.6 Gyr, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-156 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Lafarga et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.tmp..940L/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
